Fund for the 21st Century  
The Boston Foundation offers three separate investment pools within the Fund for the 21st Century. These three pools allow donors to select the option that best matches the time horizon of their charitable giving plans. Donors may also customize their asset allocation by investing among all three pools. The pools include the Balanced Plus Pool, the Impact Pool, and the Short Term Pool. The Balanced Plus Pool asset mix is expected to produce the highest long-term investment return. Accordingly, the Boston Foundation invests its endowment assets primarily in the Balanced Plus Pool.  

Financial Oversight
